newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICAN STOCK MARKET CLOSING REPORT.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICAN STOCK MARKET CLOSING REPORT.

text.p: The industrial index added 16.7 points to 8,261.0 points, all-shares rose 8.6 to 7,153.8 and golds were off 2.9 points to 1,562.9 points.

Dealers said that Sasol was the feature of the day, climbing 150 cents to 50 rand. Rainbow added five cents to 100 cents, De Beers -- due to announce year results on Tuesday -- put on 200 cents to 157.50 rand.
Dealers said that much activity had been futures-driven with players in that market trying to sell down and pump up cash stocks to reap profits and win bargains on futures.
Near-term industrial equity futures were weak at the start of trade and then steadied with contracts hovering slightly under previous settlement prices.
All-share futures were also hugging settlement levels, while golds dipped a little, despite bullion's firmness.
